prohibition_reason: Chairman directive. The castle is named from the land, not from a family.
naming_law: NATIVE LAND + LANGUAGE + HISTORY. A name with no derivation is an assignment, and assignments are refused.

native_name_candidates.name: Ederehald

derivation.language: Native tongue of EdereAriah (CANDIDATE — the language itself is unnamed in the backend)
derivation.history: The structure remained while its occupants, its trades and its families changed. It is named for what it did, not for who held it.

morphemes.gloss: that which remains, that which endures — the root the land name itself carries
a holding, a keep, a thing kept

native_name_candidates.strength: Ties the castle directly to the land name and to the one fact true in every era: it is still standing.
native_name_candidates.weakness: Says nothing about the site itself. Any enduring building in EdereAriah could carry it.

native_name_candidates.name: Ariahdura

derivation.history: The site has always been the point at which people enter the land and leave it — gate, customs house, receiving hall, and under Time Run, threshold between living eras.

morphemes.gloss: given ground, the land, that which was granted
threshold, doorway, the place of crossing

native_name_candidates.strength: Earns its name from the site's function and pre-carries the Time Run threshold role without needing Time Run to justify it.
native_name_candidates.weakness: If ENTRY_EXIT does not resolve to threshold sites, the name points at a mechanic that was not chosen.

native_name_candidates.name: Torvaenah

derivation.history: Named for how it was first sighted from the water: high stone standing toward the approach, visible before anything else on the shore.

morphemes.gloss: facing the water, turned toward the approach

derivation.reading: The high stone that faces the water.

native_name_candidates.strength: Purely geographic. True in every era regardless of who holds the castle or which mechanics are selected.
native_name_candidates.weakness: Requires the water relation to be fixed as an invariant before the name can be sealed.
